item.title: YouTuber CityEd Unveils Detailed GTA-Style Map of London
item.description: A fan cartographer has reimagined London within the Grand Theft Auto universe, applying Rockstar Games' signature satirical naming conventions and exaggerated landmarks to the city.

item.title: GTA 5 Nintendo Switch Port Canceled After Alleged Take-Two Cease-and-Desist
item.description: Modder Mojso has halted their unofficial Grand Theft Auto 5 port for Nintendo Switch, citing an alleged cease-and-desist from Take-Two Interactive, just days before its planned release.

item.title: How Grand Theft Auto Built Its Open-World Identity
item.description: A source-led look at the design ideas that connect Grand Theft Auto's changing cities, player freedom and satirical storytelling.
